title: HITBER
summary: A new tablet test based on the Mini-Mental, with interactive tasks that are scored by an algorithm.
description:
HITBER is a new digital test based on the Mini-Mental, designed for tablets.

Classic tasks such as free writing, complex drawing and serial subtraction are replaced with interactive tasks scored by an algorithm: copying a shape by dragging its pieces, building a sentence from word cards, and answering picture-based questions.

No typing or voice recognition is needed; clear instructions and predefined choices keep it simple for older adults.

## Status
HITBER completed **two rounds of clinical trials with more than 100 patients**, including a pilot at Protea in the Village. It is part of the [Digital Cognitive Test Battery](/projects/digital-cognitive-tests).
